name: Wallet8
tagline: Open-Source Secure Post-Quantum-Safe Digital Wallet Platform That Heals and Scales Itself.
heroDescription: The wallet role of the credential stack. Scan an issuer's offer, hold the credential sealed, and present only the claims a verifier asked for - consent first, every time.
pillarsLead: Wallet8 inherits the Sentin8 security model by construction and adds the wallet role's own guarantees - sealed credentials, device-bound proofs, and consent on every presentation.

pillars.title: Consent before data
pillars.summary: No presentation leaves the wallet without an explicit consent step showing the exact claim set the verifier requested - never the whole credential.

pillars.title: Sealed credential vault
pillars.summary: Every credential is stored as an AES-256-GCM envelope in the holder service: plaintext credentials never exist in an application table, only a sealed slot per user.

pillars.title: Device-bound proofs
pillars.summary: One device key per wallet; issuance proofs and DPoP tokens are sender-constrained, so a stolen credential is inert without the private key.

pillars.title: Standards, not approximations
pillars.summary: OID4VCI 1.0, OID4VP 1.0, DCQL selection, encrypted responses, the DC API and the Token Status List are implemented section by section from the normative text.

pillars.title: Revocation-aware
pillars.summary: The status sync walks the Token Status List and the vault reflects it - a revoked credential stops presenting instead of failing at the verifier.

units.name: Wallet8:Holder
units.summary: The holder backend: the encrypted credential vault, device-key registration, the authorization-code orchestration (prepare/complete), the deferred poll, presentation resolve/deliver, presentation history, and the status sync.

apps.name: Wallet8:Wallet
apps.summary: The reference Flutter web wallet: the vault, the scan intake, the consent preview, the error screen, and the outcome landing - plus the W3C Digital Credentials API shim.

sdks.name: wallet8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The `wallet8` facade: the OID4VCI issuance client and the OID4VP presentation client (request verification, Client Identifier Prefixes, DCQL, vp_token assembly, encrypted responses, the DC API) plus the holder contracts.

sdks.name: wallet8 Flutter SDK
sdks.summary: The Flutter wallet SDK: the credential store, the OID4VCI/OID4VP drivers (session-based consent flow, deferred polling, the authorize round), and the status sync - what a vertical's branded wallet embeds.

showcaseLead: Wallet8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own - identity, events, storage, secrets, and supervision come from the platform services, and the issuer/verifier roles stay in Sentin8:Auth.

showcase.name: Sentin8 - the platform
showcase.summary: 18 services: identity, credentials, events, storage, secrets, trust - everything Wallet8 doesn't rebuild.

showcase.name: Bank8
showcase.summary: Embeds the wallet8 SDKs for its branded identity wallet (the Bank8 Wallet).
